Inputs are strings in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
The count is inclusive of both start and end dates.
Weekends are Saturday and Sunday; only these are excluded.
If start date is after end date, the function returns
Dates are valid calendar dates; no validation for invalid dates is required.
, should the count include both endpoints
Return the business-day count between two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), excluding weekends
For the date range 2024-02-26 to 2024-03-01, should the count include both endpoints (Mon–Fri = 5 business days)
or exclude the start date (Tue–Fri = 4 business days)?
Assumptions (made explicit, each has a test):
• Inputs are strings in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
• The count is inclusive of both start and end dates.
• Weekends are Saturday and Sunday; only these are excluded.
• If start date is after end date, the function returns 0 (no negative counts).
• Dates are valid calendar dates; no validation for invalid dates is required.
• The function handles leap years correctly.
• The function handles dates across year boundaries.
It won't guess. One question for you: For the date range 2024-02-26 to 2024-03-01, should the count include both
endpoints (Mon–Fri = 5 business days) or exclude the start date (Tue–Fri = 4 business days)?
